text:
Type: low metal coffee table on casters
Use: holding drinks, magazines or a TV, moving around easily; living room, kids room, studio
Style: industrial, retro, minimalist
Materials: white powder-coated steel, visible screws, rubber wheels
Colors: white, light grey wheels
Shape: rectangular top with rounded edges, open lower shelf, square tube legs, four swivel casters, cart-like, compact
Feel: practical, clean, light, playful
Goes with: white walls, light wood, colorful textiles; Scandinavian or industrial small living rooms and studios

product.name: IKEA PS 2012
product.description: The castors make it easy to move the table if needed.
